{{Quote|It's a ''mimnil''. In its immature state, it looks like a juvenile ''viirsun''. It kills the original offspring and replaces them. When it's ready to molt, it attacks its adoptive mother. I've been watching this one for a while.|Veradun's adoptive father|<ref name="Insider124">{{InsiderCite|124|The Old Republic: The Third Lesson}}</ref>}}
'''Mimnil''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Bird/Legends|avian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that could be found in [[Darth Malgus|Veradun's]] [[Darth Malgus's family estate|family estate]].

==Biology and appearance==
Mimnil were a non-sentient bird species. When young, the species was almost indistinguishable from a juvenile viirsun.

==Behavior==
Young mimnil were known to take advantage of the fact they were indistinguishable from a juvenile viirsun, killing viirsun offspring and replacing them, when it is ready to molt, it attacks and kills its adoptive mother.
